note: Names for DOS LOOM EGA variables, bits, scripts, actors, rooms and sounds. Every entry carries its evidence: decoded (read from instructions), engine (ScummVM engines/scumm behaviour), reading (an interpretation from the game's own text or the way scripts use it, not verified in a run), play (seen in play). Source points to docs/loom/LOOM_SCRIPT_MAP.md or a validation record. Things not listed here stay unnamed on purpose.
